heading: This Afternoon
text: Mostly to partly cloudy. Chance of a shower, except likely early from the Green Mountains eastward. Highs in the mid to upper 60s, some lower 60s northeast. South winds 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly cloudy. Scattered evening showers or a rumble of thunder, mainly north. Areas of fog. Lows from the mid 40s to lower 50s north, and low to mid 50s in the south, with some upper 50s possible far south. Southwest winds 5 to 10 mph, becoming west and diminishing.

heading: Friday
text: Areas of early fog; otherwise mostly cloudy. Showers likely in southern New Hampshire, mainly after noon; slight chance north to the White Mountains and in southern Vermont; chance of late-day showers in far northern New York. Highs in the low to mid 60s, mid to upper 60s southeast. Variable winds around 5 mph.
